title: Seoul eyes long-term digital infrastructure projects via sovereign wealth fund
caption:
South Korea is preparing a sovereign wealth fund launching in 2027 to supply patient capital for large-scale digital infrastructure and strategic tech. By de-risking long-term hardware and AI projects, Seoul aims to draw in cautious private capital.

Source: En - Seoul eyes long-term digital infrastructure projects via sovereign wealth fund
